justification: Both surfaces show low-relief, schematic compositions organized in stacked horizontal zones, with profile animals/bird-like creatures and repeated sign-like or geometric bands; the most specific commonality is the combination of animal figures with horizontal patterned registers on a vertical decorated face. The biggest difference is that B presents a clearer ordered animal panel with distinct large creatures and top sign motifs, while A appears more densely packed and includes a prominent central anthropomorphic or composite figure/register structure not matched in B.
